content_units.safe_meaning: In Python 3.14 the free-threaded build is officially supported and no longer experimental, but it remains optional.
In Python 3.13 the free-threaded mode was experimental and not enabled by default.
Making free-threading the default or only build (phase III) has not been decided and depends on factors in CPython and the community.
The 3.14 release notes put the single-threaded performance penalty of free-threaded mode at roughly 5-10%, depending on platform and C compiler.
A team can test its service on the free-threaded build now, but should not plan on it becoming the default on any known date; recheck when a phase III decision is announced.

evidence_anchors.observed_summary: Supported, no longer experimental; start of phase II; still optional.
evidence_anchors.boundary: Official status only; says nothing about third-party package readiness.

evidence_anchors.observed_summary: Phase III (default or sole build) is undecided.
evidence_anchors.boundary: No date or criteria for phase III.

evidence_anchors.observed_summary: Single-thread penalty roughly 5-10% depending on platform and compiler.
evidence_anchors.boundary: Project-reported range, not an independent benchmark.

evidence_anchors.observed_summary: Experimental and not enabled by default in 3.13.
PEP 779 criteria apply to entering phase II only; the default decision is separate.
evidence_anchors.boundary: Does not state phase III criteria.

alternatives.safe_meaning: Free-threading will become the default in the next release.

limitations.safe_meaning: The 5-10% figure is the project's own estimate and varies by platform and compiler; a team must measure its own workload.
These sources cover CPython's official position, not whether the libraries a given service depends on are ready.

prohibited_overclaims.forbidden_meaning: Free-threading is the default build in Python 3.14.
prohibited_overclaims.reason: Sources say it is optional and the default decision is undecided.

composition_plan.central_throughline: Free-threading moved from experimental to supported-but-optional in 3.14; the default switch is undecided, so test now but do not plan on a default date.
